idle.action: heavy ceremonial breathing with cloth and staff-chain secondary motion
idle.supernatural_effect: crimson eyes and rubies pulse from off to dim to peak and back

attack.action: two-handed diagonal physical staff strike from upper-right to lower-left
attack.secondary_motion: hair, heavy sleeves, skirt and staff chains lag, overshoot and settle independently
attack.supernatural_effect: eyes and rubies charge during wind-up, peak at impact and fade through recovery

transition.idle_to_attack: Queue attack on idle bridge frame 0, 4 or 7; attack frame 0 is pixel-identical to animation_base.
transition.attack_to_idle: After attack frame 7, resume idle frame 0; both are pixel-identical to animation_base.

alpha.source_fix: binary-alpha white halo reconstructed only on the outer contour before animation work
